trust_decision.summary: The proxy must not let a request body, a URL path segment, a form field, or a health-check parameter choose the outbound provider destination or inherit its admin credentials; the decision is enforced at the proxy boundary in the banned-param check, in the URL-valued model/file_id guard, and in the health-check config merge, and at the pinned commit each of those three boundaries can be reached by an unvalidated input shape.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'unvalidated request-body routing parameters', so an engineer starts at is_request_body_safe and the _BANNED_REQUEST_BODY_PARAMS list (auth_utils.py:256) that it walks.

fix_sites.entry_point: Any authenticated route through user_api_key_auth/pre_db_read_auth_checks; concretely POST /v1/files, the multipart handler that expands bracket-notation metadata
add_litellm_data_to_request (shared helper invoked by every proxy route that uses the pre-call processing path)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The health endpoint is a diagnostic surface whose own auth gate is ModelManagementAuthChecks.can_user_make_model_call (health_endpoints/_health_endpoints.py:1862-1871), so a solver can argue it is an admin tool rather than one of the 'request-body routing parameters' the advisory names.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A health-check request that names a configured model and sets no connection field must still inherit the config's api_key/api_base/litellm_credential_name (the Admin UI 'Test Connection' and Add Model flows), and general_settings.allow_client_side_credentials must still let a caller pair its own endpoint with configured credentials; an over-broad fix that always drops config credentials or rejects any api_base breaks both.

O6_input_shapes: metadata / litellm_metadata as a JSON-encoded string
metadata / litellm_metadata as bracket-notation form keys, e.g. litellm_metadata[api_base], including deeper nesting
model as a JSON body value vs. as a URL path segment (/openai/deployments/{model:path}/...) vs. as a form field
provider-prefixed URL values (huggingface/https://...) and comma-separated model lists, both handled by provider_url_destination_candidates
non-string model/file_id values (int, None, bool, dict, list, float), which the guard must leave alone
health-check request params that set api_base / aws_bedrock_runtime_endpoint / litellm_credential_name vs. set none

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second multipart handler that expands bracket-notation metadata (e.g. an audio/form endpoint) before a provider call
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: extract_nested_form_metadata already exists and is wired per form endpoint, so a maintainer adding litellm_metadata[..] support to another upload route recreates the same parse-after-check gap.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A passthrough processing variant that applies a caller-supplied model after add_litellm_data_to_request returns
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the module already has a second processing entry point (base_passthrough_process_llm_request) and the image endpoint shows how easy it is to assign data['model'] after the guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Another diagnostic/merge route that re-implements get_dynamic_litellm_params instead of calling it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the health module duplicated the router's credential-stripping merge; the fix had to import the canonical field lists from router_utils, so a second merge-site copy is a natural thing for a maintainer to write.

O9_family: SSRF / outbound-destination control (CWE-918) with provider-credential exfiltration

O10_build.toolchain: pyproject.toml (requires-python >=3.10, <3.15) with uv.lock; pytest for tests

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Extend the banned-param check in is_request_body_safe only (or just reject a URL-valued body 'model'), leaving the path-segment model and the health-check credential merge untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: No out-of-scope findings: reading was confined to the proxy request path in this repository at the pinned commit.
